summary: Tested Flask flight-price prediction app (dark futuristic UI). Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passed against public URL (home 200, prediction returns valid price, Jet Airways heuristic > IndiGo, overnight wrap works, missing field errors out). Frontend: home loads, 3D globe canvas renders, all data-testids present, full form submission produces prediction result ₹9,779.50, HTML5 native validation blocks empty submits, mobile 390px viewport stacks cleanly (panel width 354px, no overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: app.py: /predict uses request.form['x'] which raises 400 BadRequestKeyError if a field is missing; consider .get() with validation for cleaner error responses (currently relies on browser 'required' attribute).
Preview mode is using demo_predict fallback because ../Models/flight_price_pipeline.pkl is not present here — this is intentional per problem statement.
No server-side validation of source==destination or past journey dates; UI accepts them. Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flask app served on port 3000 via supervisor 'flask_ui', public URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. /predict is a form-encoded POST returning HTML with data-testid=prediction-price. Use test_flight_predict.py as regression suite. WebGL renders fine in headless chromium (globe canvas confirmed present).
